source.author: ov
source.text: Nec satis est, ipsos etiam pedibusque manuque turbavere lacus imoque e gurgite mollem huc illuc limum saltu movere maligno.
source.text_original: Nec satis est, ipsos etiam pedibusque manuque / turbavere lacus imoque e gurgite mollem / huc illuc limum saltu movere maligno.
source.text_english: Nor was it enough: they also disturbed the lakes with their feet and hands and, from the deep whirlpool, maliciously stirred the soft mud here and there with a leap.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: iam placidis ratis exstat aquis, quam gurgite ab imo et Thetis et magnis Nereus socer erigit ulnis.
reuse.text_original: iam placidis ratis exstat aquis, quam gurgite ab imo / et Thetis et magnis Nereus socer erigit ulnis.
reuse.text_english: Now the raft stands above the calm waters, which Thetis and Nereus, her great father-in-law, lift with their arms from the deep abyss.
